extracted.intended_audience: donors, prospective funders, researchers, partner institutions, and the general public interested in cancer research funding
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational priorities and impact goals for a nonprofit that raises funds and coordinates collaborative cancer research, describing what kinds of work it supports and the outcomes it aims to achieve.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mission — raise awareness and fund research to detect and treat cancers
rubrics_metrics.description: Stand Up To Cancer’s mission is to raise awareness and fund research to detect and treat cancers with the aspiration to cure all patients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Donations and fundraising directly support collaborative cancer research programs; the organization positions itself as a convener that drives research to discover new therapies and get them to patients quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority: Make early-stage detection a standard of care
rubrics_metrics.description: Stand Up To Cancer has set a bold goal to make early-stage detection an essential part of the standard of care for all cancers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concrete impact targets tied to this priority: reduce cancer deaths by 25% in five years and 50% in 10 years. Emphasis on projects and initiatives that accelerate early detection research and implementation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding focus: early detection, innovative treatments, and equitable care
rubrics_metrics.description: The organization focuses funding and programs on early detection, innovative treatments, and ensuring equitable care.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grants, collaborations, and initiatives should align with improving detection, developing novel therapies, and addressing equity in access and outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strategic pillars: harness AI, invest in cancer vaccines, advance precision therapies
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategy includes leveraging artificial intelligence for early-stage detection, investing in cancer vaccines, and advancing precision therapies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preference or emphasis is implied for research that applies AI to detection, develops or tests cancer vaccine approaches, or advances precision/targeted treatment strategies; collaborative, technology-forward projects are highlighted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborative research model — unite top scientists and institutions
rubrics_metrics.description: Stand Up To Cancer drives cutting-edge research by uniting top scientists and collaborators to form research teams and accelerate progress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The organization funds multi-institutional collaborations (dream teams, research teams) and supports cross-disciplinary partnerships aimed at rapid translation to clinical trials and patient impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Impact and scale metrics (organizational performance indicators)
rubrics_metrics.description: At-a-glance quantitative indicators of SU2C’s scale and impact, including numbers of collaborating institutions, researchers funded, clinical trials, research teams, and clinical trial patients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed figures: 210+ collaborating institutions, 3,100+ researchers funded, 280+ clinical trials, 126+ research teams, 37,000+ clinical trial patients — these serve as evidence of reach and outcomes that prospective partners and funders can reference.

rubrics_metrics.name: Donor-facing options and accessibility for giving
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple ways to give are provided (tax-deductible donations, donor advised funds, donate stock, vehicle or real estate donations, gift cards, airline miles, merchandise purchases).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical guidance for donors: different giving mechanisms are available to make supporting SU2C easy and tax-advantageous; messaging emphasizes that contributions directly support collaborative research programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fundraising and engagement channels — community-driven campaigns
rubrics_metrics.description: SU2C encourages supporters to start fundraisers and campaigns (birthday, legacy, sports, celebration, grateful patient, etc.) to support research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fundraising by individuals and communities is framed as a way to back innovative research and accelerate therapies to patients; guidance implies support for varied campaign types and peer-to-peer fundraising.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public communication and storytelling as impact tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Use of patient stories, news, documentaries, and press releases to raise awareness and demonstrate impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Narratives (patient journeys, documentary films, press announcements) are used to highlight the importance of research funding and to engage donors, partners, and the public.
